composition_subtypes.role: sort by initial counts to process groups in order
at each level, pop largest t_i to leave behind, accumulate cost for remaining smaller t_i
max-heap to efficiently retrieve the largest t_i in each group

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort by a_i to group, then use max-heap to greedily keep smallest t_i for further increments, paying sum of remaining at each level.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables grouping by equal a_i; max-heap facilitates greedy selection of which t_i to discard at each level to minimize incremental cost.
